assets.prompt_recipe: Reconstructed prompt intent, not verbatim source prompt. Show a researcher at a warm paper-covered desk tracing one highlighted sentence across scattered research sheets to a small evidence note with a gold path. Editorial illustration, deep navy and cream with muted blue and restrained ochre. Keep the researcher and papers visible. Place exact title 'Trace each claim' and exact subtitle 'From scattered sources to reviewable evidence' in open space. Do not show fake data, metrics, or dense UI.
assets.alt_text: A researcher reads a paper at a desk where an ochre line connects a highlighted claim across scattered pages to a small evidence card.
assets.usage: README lead visual; place after the one-sentence project description.
assets.crop_behavior: Use the full wide frame; preserve the researcher on the left and the title block on the right. At narrow widths, stack image at full width without cropping the title.
assets.rejection_conditions: Reject if the headline is misspelled, the connecting line obscures the papers, the reader is hidden, or added text implies unverified automation.
